messages.subject: why can not keep the synchronize while running the same coding in Rstudio and URL link
parts:
Dear Zhian

I meet a very strange problem that I have the following coding which runs normally in Rstudio, 

p <- plot_ly(data = pca.df, x =~pca.df[,paste0('Axis',sel.xaxis)], y =  ~pca.df[,paste0('Axis',sel.yaxis)], mode = "markers",color = ~popnames,marker=~list(size=8,color=color),text=~paste0('Ind. name= ',ind.names,"\n ,Pop:", popnames)

But error appears when I open the URL link as following: error:unique() applies only to vectors


If I change the above code to : (delete the symbol ~)

p <- plot_ly(data = pca.df, x =pca.df[,paste0('Axis',sel.xaxis)], y =  pca.df[,paste0('Axis',sel.yaxis)], mode = "markers",color = popnames,marker=list(size=8,color=color),text=paste0('Ind. name= ',ind.names,"\n ,Pop:", popnames))

It runs normally in URL link instead, but error appears when runs in Rstudio like following: error:  object color not find. 

I have no idea about it. May I ask if you know how to solve it?

Thank you in advance
Ying
